# TN-Proto

TN-Proto shares encrypted, signed data between applications. Fields belong to
named groups; each group's matching key opens its fields. Applications can add
use decisions through callbacks supplied with the verified writer and contracts.
Rust implements the protocol, with Python bindings through PyO3.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/README.md): installation, first object, bank/vendor exchange, and API overview.
- [Python API](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/GOVERNED_PYTHON_API.md): sessions, data objects, publications, decisions, capabilities, and datasets.
- [Rust SDK](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/rust-sdk/README.md): Rust setup and working examples.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/ts-sdk/README.md): Node and browser entry points.
- [Protocol reference](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/guide/protocol.md): envelope, signature, group, and cipher encoding.

## Object operations

`Session` holds an identity, group capabilities, contracts, and configured decisions.
`DataObject` holds editable data and its last signed publication.
`GovernedObject` holds signed bytes for storage and transport.

| Operation | Python surface |
| --- | --- |
| Create | `session.create(fields, policy)` |
| Unseal | `session.unseal(publication, purpose=..., decide=...)` |
| Read and edit fields | `data.get(name)`, `data.set(name, value)` |
| Select output fields | `data.select(groups, fields=...)` |
| Retain contributors | `data.include(other)` |
| Add a contract | `data.attach(policy, decide=...)` |
| Seal a result | `data.seal(purpose=..., to=..., decide=...)` |
| Load and save | `GovernedObject.read(path)`, `publication.write(path)` |
| Transport bytes | `publication.forward()` |

A `Workflow` binds configured receive and release purposes. It exposes
`unseal`/`receive`, `attach`, and `seal`/`release` for repeated operations.

## Keys and integrations

- [Provider reference](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/GOVERNED_PROVIDERS.md): identity, key, governance, catalog, and register interfaces.
- [Management systems](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/MANAGEMENT_SYSTEMS.md): provisioned key loading, live decisions, credential caching, and S3 storage encryption.
- [Persistent keys](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/python/examples/persistent_keys/README.md): setup, publication, and reading in separate processes.
- [Unity Catalog](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/UNITY_CATALOG.md): locating TN objects and selecting dataset editions.
- [Application examples](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/python/examples/enterprise/README.md): fifteen service and storage patterns.

`GroupCapability` accepts BTN reader kits or publisher state, JWE recipient
keys, and HIBE public parameters or scoped reader keys. `FileKeyStore` saves
and loads application signing and group material. A `KeyProvider` supplies
assigned capabilities when a session is created.

## Event and package APIs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/guide/getting-started.md): ceremony setup, event emission, reading, and CLI usage.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/guide/yaml-reference.md): supported YAML settings and handlers.
- [Environment variables](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/guide/environment-variables.md): active environment settings.
- [Authentication](https://github.com/cyaxios/tn-proto/blob/main/docs/guide/auth.md): account and vault operations.

Python `tn.export` creates `admin_log_snapshot`, `offer`, `enrolment`,
`kit_bundle`, `full_keystore`, `identity_seed`, and `project_seed` packages.
`tn.absorb` reads and applies supported signed packages.

## Source and license

- Canonical Rust: `crypto/tn-core/`.
- PyO3 bindings: `crypto/tn-core-py/`; combined extension: `crypto/tn-py/`.
- Python package: `python/tn/`.
- Standalone SDKs: `rust-sdk/`, `ts-sdk/`, and `csharp-sdk/`.
